name: arize-phoenix
description: Connect Cursor to your Phoenix instance and teach the agent how to debug traces, run evals, and instrument with OpenInference.

PHOENIX_MCP_URL.title: Phoenix MCP URL
PHOENIX_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint for your Phoenix instance. Leave the default for local Phoenix. For self-hosted Phoenix, use https://your-phoenix.example.com/mcp. Cursor authenticates with OAuth on first use.
